local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local period=0;local joined=nil;local elapsed=0;local reported=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if core.isWorldPaused() then return end
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died at original Tower Portal')
 elapsed=elapsed+dt;period=period+dt;if period<.2 then return end;period=0
 if self.cell.id~=core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x1d0c8) then
  print('KvatchDoor portal control ready position='..tostring(self.position));return
 end
 if not reported then print('KvatchDoor entered Blood Feast');reported=true end
 for _,obj in ipairs(nearby.actors) do
  if obj.id=='0x1098138' then
   assert(not types.Actor.isDead(obj),'Ilend died at the door')
   if not joined then joined=elapsed end
   local delta=obj.position-self.position
   local horizontal=math.sqrt(delta.x*delta.x+delta.y*delta.y)
   local a=types.Actor.getPathfindingAgentBounds(self).halfExtents
   local b=types.Actor.getPathfindingAgentBounds(obj).halfExtents
   local minimum=math.max(a.x,a.y)+math.max(b.x,b.y)
   print(string.format('KvatchDoor follower gap=%.3f minimum=%.3f player=%s ilend=%s health=%.3f',horizontal,minimum,tostring(self.position),tostring(obj.position),types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current))
   if elapsed-joined>=5 then
    assert(horizontal>minimum+.1,'Follower remains inside Player envelope')
    assert(horizontal<400 and math.abs(delta.z)<64,'Follower arrival is not bounded near the original landing')
    local ground=nearby.castRay(obj.position+util.vector3(0,0,32),obj.position-util.vector3(0,0,64),{{collisionType=nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.World+nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.Door+nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.HeightMap}})
    assert(ground.hit and ground.hitNormal.z>.6,'Follower arrival has no walkable support')
    local gap=obj.position.z-ground.hitPos.z
    assert(gap>=-.1 and gap<48,'Follower is embedded in or floating above the floor')
    print('KvatchDoor follower clearance verified')
   end
  end
 end
end}}}}
